chadickith.why: He lived through the Pyre because I bled into him, and he is Banked now. The love is no lighter for the guilt, but I now see what I cost him.

kitwin.why: smells the gladness on the boy

oselle-velun.why: believes she hates him, and she does

gwenmund-cobb.why: She heard the price of the Quenching in plain words and refused it. She will hold the heat with Isine. Her refusal was sound.

isine-kettle.why: She came to my forge carrying the burn and a slow poison, and she is willing to learn to bleed the heat.

agenda.text: Bring the Gallowsbird down tonight, before it takes Small Tusk or more of Kharun
Keep the Heartcoal and the ash wafers away from everyone, myself most of all
Tell Small Tusk what the Quenching costs, and what it has made of him, before the fury shows
Make sure the Banked can put me down when I turn (unspoken)
Teach Isine Kettle to bleed off the heat, so the Order can shelter the burn without another Quenching
Shelter Tam and Mina Cobb in the Order if their mother dies, and keep the forge ward running until the burn is cured or lost
